desc.zh-CN: OpenAI官方最新推出的备受外界期待的、性能更强的新一代人工智能模型GPT-5.
desc.en-US: The latest, highly anticipated and powerful next-generation LLM named GPT-5 that officially launched by OpenAI.

desc.zh-CN: o3是openai发布的最新深度思考模型，其基线指标大幅超越上一代模型。
desc.en-US: O3 is the latest reasoning model released by OpenAI, with baseline metrics significantly surpassing previous models.

desc.zh-CN: GLM发布的新一代GLM-4.6系列开源推理模型。
desc.en-US: The new GLM-4.6 reasoning model series released by GLM.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen3是Qwen系列中最新一代的大型语言模型，提供了一套全面的密集模型和MoE模型。
desc.en-US: Qwen3 is the latest generation of large language models in Qwen series, offering a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.

desc.zh-CN: Anthropic最新发布的闭源推理模型系列，在智能体构建、计算机使用、推理和数学能力上展现出显著突破。
desc.en-US: The latest series of closed-source reasoning models released by Anthropic, which has shown significant breakthroughs in agent construction, computer usage, reasoning, and mathematical abilities.

desc.zh-CN: high模式下的o4-mini，响应时间更长，具有更强的推理能力。
desc.en-US: o4-mini in high mode, which has a longer response time and stronger reasoning ability.

desc.zh-CN: 科大讯飞发布的推理模型星火X1的10月最新版本。
desc.en-US: The latest version of Starfire X1 released by iFlytek in October.

desc.zh-CN: Deepseek R1的最新版本。
desc.en-US: The latest version of Deepseek R1.

desc.zh-CN: 字节豆包发布的深度思考模型，支持手动开关深度思考能力，其性能对比1.5 代模型大幅提升。
desc.en-US: The deep reasoning model released by ByteDance, which supports manual switching of deep reasoning, and its performance is significantly improved compared to doubao-1.5.

desc.zh-CN: xAI推出的Grok模型系列的最新版。
desc.en-US: The latest version of the Grok model series released by xAI.

desc.zh-CN: 由OpenAI发布的近年来首个开源模型系列gpt-oss。
desc.en-US: The GPT-OSS series, the first open-source model family released by OpenAI in recent years.

desc.zh-CN: gemini2.5-pro模型的正式发布版本。
desc.en-US: The official release version of the Gemini 2.5 pro.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen模型中最新发布的Qwen3-Next系列，通过创新的模型架构改进Scaling效率。
desc.en-US: The latest released Qwen3-Next series in Qwen models, improving scaling efficiency through innovative model architecture.

desc.zh-CN: 由腾讯公司自主研发的深度思考模型，所采用的版本号为hunyuan-t1-20250822。
desc.en-US: The deep reasoning model independently developed by Tencent adopts the version number hunyuan-t1-20250822.

desc.zh-CN: 百灵语言大模型系列是由蚂蚁集团百灵团队自主研发，具备优秀的语义理解、指令遵循和文本生成等能力，能够有效解决推理、知识、代码及数学等任务。
desc.en-US: The Bailing LLM series is independently developed by Ant Group Bailing team. It demonstrates exceptional capabilities in semantic understanding, instruction following, and text generation, enabling it to effectively tackle tasks involving reasoning, knowledge, coding, and mathematics.

desc.zh-CN: Anthropic最新发布的闭源推理模型系列，在智能体构建、计算机使用、推理和数学能力上展现出显著突破。
desc.en-US: The latest series of closed-source reasoning models released by Anthropic, which has shown significant breakthroughs in agent construction, computer usage, reasoning, and mathematical abilities.

desc.zh-CN: Seed-OSS是字节跳动开发的开源大型语言模型，旨在提供强大的长上下文、推理、代理和通用功能，以及通用的开发人员友好功能。
desc.en-US: Seed-OSS is an open-source large language model developed by ByteDance's Seed Team, designed for powerful long-context, reasoning, agent and general capabilities, and versatile developer-friendly features.

desc.zh-CN: 由蚂蚁集团发布的金融领域大模型。
desc.en-US: The financial domain LLM released by Ant Group.

desc.zh-CN: Deepseek V3系列模型的最新实验版本。
desc.en-US: The latest experimental version of Deepseek V3 series models.

desc.zh-CN: Nanbeige3.5-Pro-Thinking 是 BOSS直聘自研的“南北阁”系列强化推理版本，面向通用与招聘场景。
desc.en-US: Nanbeige3.5-Pro-Thinking is a reasoning-enhanced version of the self-developed Nanbeige series by BOSS Zhipin, designed for both general and recruitment-specific scenarios.

desc.zh-CN: Minimax最新发布的旗舰模型，具有卓越的通用能力、先进的编程能力、强大的智能体性能以及高效的架构设计。
desc.en-US: The latest flagship model released by Minimax features excellent general capabilities, advanced programming capabilities, powerful agent performance, and efficient architecture design.

desc.zh-CN: 由月之暗面公司最新推出的模型，具备更强代码能力、更擅长通用Agent任务。所使用版本号为kimi-k2-instruct-0905。
desc.en-US: The latest model launched by Moonshot AI, featuring enhanced coding capabilities and superior performance in general Agent tasks, which adopts the version number kimi-k2-instruct-0905.

desc.zh-CN: 科大讯飞发布的推理模型星火X1的10月最新版本。
desc.en-US: The latest version of Starfire X1 released by iFlytek in October.

desc.zh-CN: 百灵语言大模型系列是由蚂蚁集团百灵团队自主研发，具备优秀的语义理解、指令遵循和文本生成等能力，能够有效解决推理、知识、代码及数学等任务。
desc.en-US: The Bailing LLM series is independently developed by Ant Group Bailing team. It demonstrates exceptional capabilities in semantic understanding, instruction following, and text generation, enabling it to effectively tackle tasks involving reasoning, knowledge, coding, and mathematics.

desc.zh-CN: 腾讯最新发布的开源MoE模型。
desc.en-US: The latest open-sourced MoE model released by Tencent.

desc.zh-CN: Llama 4模型是自回归语言模型，它使用混合专家（MoE）架构，并结合了原生多模态的早期融合。
desc.en-US: The Llama 4 models are auto-regressive language models that use a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture and incorporate early fusion for native multimodality.

desc.zh-CN: Gemma 是来自谷歌的一系列轻量级、最先进的开源模型家族，这些模型基于创建Gemini模型相同的研究和技术构建而成。
desc.en-US: Gemma is a family of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models from Google, built from the same research and technology used to create the Gemini models.
